title: 4-SPEED TRANS-INTERLOCK LINKAGE & V.I.N. LOCATION
summary: 4-speed manual transmission (M20 wide-ratio, M21 close-ratio, M22 heavy-duty 'rock crusher'): the back drive (reverse interlock) cable from the steering column lever to the transmission reverse lever, the transmission assemblies themselves, and the M22 tag. The cable is held to the transmission by a clip and a bracket that bolt to the case with transmission-supplied bolts; its rod end is pinned to the reverse lever with a washer and cotter pin. View A shows the VIN stamping location on the transmission case.

materials.where: back drive cable end at the column lever, and the cable rod at the reverse lever

fastening.note: Clip [1] around the cable is bolted to the transmission case; the bolt is marked (TRANS), i.e. supplied with the transmission, no callout on this sheet.
Bracket [4] bolted to the transmission case with a bolt marked (TRANS), supplied with the transmission; no separate callout.
Cable [2] sleeve end is held in bracket [4] by retainer clip [3].
Cable [2] rod end passes through the reverse lever, washer [6] on, locked with cotter pin [5]. Grease 12m at the joint.

fastening.to: lever on steering column (part of column assembly)
fastening.note: Column end of the cable attaches to the column lever; 12m grease. Cable installation see UPC 7; bracket assembly at column see UPC 9.
M22 tag [8] hangs from a case bolt near the VIN location in View A; attachment method not detailed.
